notes.general_comments:
There were 529 candidates all from New Zealand Centres with a mean score of 19.32 and a standard
deviation of 4.90. Although no candidate scored full marks, 8 made a single error and only three candidates
scored below the guessing level. While the general performance was impressive there were a greater than
normal number of questions that were relatively easy, and were at the top end of the test’s design limit. Two
questions proved relatively difficult. The statistics confirmed that all items were valid.
